8108.title: Pi manual-compaction settlement recovery
8108.rootCauseOneLine: The session preserves an aborted-run error across successful manual compaction and continuation; the live extension ordering remains unverified.
8108.proposedFix: First establish extension recovery intent and settlement ordering with a real Pi-process fixture, then correlate recovery without hiding missing continuations or failed compactions.
8108.caveats: Synthetic event replay reproduced in two trusted-main checkouts; original third-party extension and Pi 1.6.0 were not run. Full baseline: 370 passed, 6 skipped. No production fix.
